ns2:section.sectionText: This online section will meet with the in person section via Collaborate and classroom microphones and camera. Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is NOT recommended. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see https://online.illinois.edu. This course requires the following textbook: W.H. Schlesinger and Emily S. Bernhardt, Title: Biogeochemistry: An Analysis of Global Change (3rd edition) ISBN: either 978-0123858740 or 0123858747.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
